A.notes: Covers every field with required checks on name and phone, uses a Select for time, puts date and time side by side in a FieldGroup, and adds helpful placeholders.

B.notes: Covers every field with required checks on name and phone, and a horizontal Radio suits the four time options well; slightly plainer, with no placeholders.

A.notes: Rows are pressable with a status badge, number, date, item count and total, but the filter is only bound to data and fires no change behaviour.

B.notes: Same idiomatic Segmented plus List of Rows with badges, and the filter also emits a change event, so filtering actually works.

A.notes: A Toolbar holds the search field and the member count, a responsive grid shows person cards with Avatar, Heading and role, and Message sends a stable id.

B.notes: Has every required element, but nests the person cards inside an outer Card, and the message event passes the name rather than an id.

A.notes: Has a Stepper on Workspace, a required name field, a Radio for team size, a Switch, and Back/Continue in a Toolbar inside a carded form; the default size 'solo' doesn't match any option.

B.notes: Builds the same complete set inside a described Card, with the buttons right-aligned; it shares the 'solo' default mismatch.
